meaning: primitive_gate permits implementation tests; production_enabled additionally requires feature release qualification. Values below are initial authoring state, not measurements.

versioning.structural.reason: Structural commits, scoped new-window restore and linked clean-branch structural export have focused evidence. Current-window replacement is separately blocked under VB-096; production structural release qualification remains incomplete.

versioning.live_retention.reason: Retention-owned same-profile view freeze, source-window close and resume passed on Wayland; production lifetime and renderer-loss handling remain unqualified.

versioning.archive_capture.reason: Public MHTML save, exact view/path correlation and completed state passed on Wayland; production capture orchestration remains disabled.

versioning.archive_offline.reason: The Qt 6.11.2 native hostile-MHTML fixture preserves remote CSS/image/frame/form references and observes zero archive callbacks and zero network traffic while a separate source-profile control request succeeds; this is renderer/MHTML-sandbox suppression, not per-resource interceptor-block evidence. Restricted OTR rendering and real-window cleanup pass, but broader visible multi-window/failure/release qualification remains incomplete.

versioning.semantic_restore.reason: Bounded reconstruction has not been implemented or tested.

versioning.clean_branch.reason: Visible-parent single-tab native journeys and scoped structural export pass behind unqualified-clean-branch-test. Multi-view window branching, compositor focus, popup/permission journeys, fault teardown and release qualification remain; hidden-parent retention is separate.

versioning.cookie_identity.reason: Installed QNetworkCookie parsing loses Partitioned identity; only a separately proven exact scope/backend may override.

versioning.cookie_snapshot.reason: Native loadAllCookies observations have no public completion or atomic snapshot boundary; a quiet interval is unknown.

versioning.cookie_seed_verify.reason: Synthetic SameSite Strict input returned as Default in the public native callback; general exact seed/read-back is unsupported.

versioning.cookie_merge_apply.reason: Public asynchronous mutations provide no transaction/CAS or complete concurrent-write coordination contract.
